title: Breakdown of the Pentagon UFO videos with Mick West
summary: Astronomer David Kipping of Cool Worlds talks with Mick West to break down the three declassified Pentagon UFO videos. They explain the footage through camera artifacts, glare, and perspective effects.
why: HN recommends it as the boring, convincing debunking of the Gofast, FLIR and Gimbal videos, which commenters say ended UFO hype for them.

quote.text: Mick West's breakdowns of the Pentagon UAP videos was the nail in the coffin of this era of UFO hype for me.
